Nurse takes nursing union to tribunal over transgender changing room dispute

Nurse Sandie Peggie has taken her union, the Royal College of Nursing (RCN), to an employment tribunal, alleging discrimination. Peggie claims the RCN failed to adequately support her in a dispute concerning the use of a women's changing room with a transgender doctor. She stated she "felt discriminated against" by the union.
